title: Vietnamese-Style Shrimp Satay
description: A flavorful and spicy shrimp satay dish inspired by Vietnamese cuisine, perfect for a quick dinner or snack.
instructions: 1. In a medium bowl, whisk together lime juice, satay sauce, and 1 tablespoon of oil.
2. Add the shrimp to the bowl and toss to coat. Cover and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes or up to 2 hours.
3. Preheat a grill or grill pan to medium-high heat.
4. Thread the marinated shrimp onto skewers, leaving a small space between each shrimp.
5. Brush the grill or grill pan with the remaining 1 tablespoon of oil.
6. Grill the shrimp for 2-3 minutes per side, or until pink and cooked through.
7. Garnish with cilantro, if desired. Serve immediately.
